config.name: 1m-nca-transfer-v2
config.shuffle_method: For each 1026-token trajectory, permute its 972 patch tokens across all 27 frames with a NumPy RNG seeded from [experimental seed, shuffle salt]. Keep all 27 start/end grid markers at their original positions. This preserves each trajectory's token multiset, length, marker layout, rule split, and optimization budget while destroying patch order.

interpretation.criteria: A descriptive heuristic, not a significance test: consistent positive requires at least three regimes to beat scratch by >=0.05 mean loss and in >=4/5 paired seeds; structure-specific additionally requires 40_50 to beat shuffled_nca by >=0.05 mean and in >=4/5 seeds. Complexity sensitivity compares final mean regime gap with mean within-regime seed SD.
